analysis.title: Corporate KPI Binary Options: A New Way to Trade Earnings
key_insights: Prediction market monthly volume grew almost 15x in the past year to a high of over $126B in October. Retail traders dominate, with Kalshi and Polymarket the two main platforms.
Sports is 82% of Kalshi volume, followed by crypto at 13%.

Corporate event contracts split into earnings-mention contracts and corporate KPI contracts. KPI contracts are the fastest growing segment, going from under 10% of corporate event contracts traded on Kalshi in January to over half by July.
Kalshi expanded its corporate KPI offering from 16 active series in January to 248 in August 2026.

Kalshi KPI order count grew 22-fold from January through August 2026 versus the same period in 2025. Median order shrank from roughly $15-20 of premium to about $5. Nine in ten KPI orders are $100 or less in premium.

Retail favors longshots: 37% of Kalshi KPI contracts traded at 10 cents or less. About two-thirds of KPI volume occurred on weekends or outside US regular market hours, often around after-the-close earnings releases.

Cboe is listing cash-settled, European-style binary call and put options on company KPIs such as EPS, revenue, segment revenue and operating margin. Each contract pays $1 if the reported KPI meets the stated condition at expiration, $0 otherwise.
At launch the binary options cover 112 KPIs across 23 actively traded US companies.

Unlike Kalshi's CFTC-regulated event contracts, Cboe's KPI binary options are securities options regulated by the SEC, with FINRA oversight, a standardized disclosure document, and broker suitability and options-approval requirements. They trade on Cboe Options Exchange (C1) and clear through Cboe Clear US rather than the OCC.
Cboe expects the securities options structure to ease institutional adoption and sees use cases from earnings hedging to relative value spread trades that could bring larger orders and two-way flow.

Cboe argues KPI options isolate fundamental results from the stock's price reaction, which also depends on positioning, guidance, multiple re-rating and the macro tape. A fund long AAPL could buy an EPS put to hedge a miss without paying the vega and gamma in standard equity option premium.

A KPI option price gives the market-implied probability that a KPI clears a level (30 cents implies roughly 30%). Cboe suggests comparing it with equity option implied volatility and skew to flag mispricings.
Cboe proposes AI-exposure hedges using puts on NVDA and AMD data center revenue (capex cycle) or MSFT, AMZN and GOOGL cloud revenue and META operating margin (monetization).
Cboe proposes a cyclical basket to hedge credit and downturn risk: JPM, C and BAC credit loss provisions, TGT apparel vs food and beverage sales, META and GOOGL YouTube ad revenue, and Ford Blue.
earnings_insights: Cboe says a stock can beat earnings and still sell off because the reaction depends on positioning, guidance, multiple re-rating and the macro tape. KPI binary options are positioned as a way to trade the reported metric alone.
Example contracts listed by Cboe: AAPL EPS (KAAPL), AAPL revenue (KBAPL), AAPL iPhone net sales (KCAPL), AMZN AWS revenue (KCAMZ), META operating margin (KEMET), SMCI gross margin (KCSMC).
crypto_views: Crypto is 13% of Kalshi prediction market volume, second to sports at 82%.
Coinbase monthly users and Coinbase trading volume are among the top 10 most traded KPI series on Kalshi (0.57M and 0.52M contracts, Jan-Aug 2026).

trade_ideas.description: Buy AAPL EPS binary put (KAAPL) to hedge a long AAPL position into earnings
trade_ideas.rationale: Protects against an EPS miss without paying the vega and gamma in the volatility premium of a standard equity option.

trade_ideas.description: Buy puts on NVDA and AMD data center revenue (KCNVD, KCAMD) to hedge the AI capex cycle
trade_ideas.rationale: Data center revenue tracks how much hyperscalers spend on AI chips.

trade_ideas.description: Buy puts on MSFT, AMZN or GOOGL cloud revenue (KDMSF, KCAMZ, KDGOG) or META operating margin (KEMET) to hedge AI monetization risk
trade_ideas.rationale: Isolates the monetization layer of AI spending without the multiple compression and sentiment priced into stock puts.

trade_ideas.description: Long call on AMD data center revenue (KCAMD) vs put on NVDA data center revenue (KCNVD), or the reverse, as a peer relative-value spread
trade_ideas.rationale: Expresses an 'X takes share from Y' view separate from either stock's price performance.

trade_ideas.description: Basket of puts on credit loss provisions at JPM, C and BAC (KDJPM, KDCIT, KDBAC), TGT apparel vs food and beverage (KDTGT, KCTGT), META and GOOGL YouTube ad revenue (KDMET, KCGOG), and Ford Blue (KEFOR) to hedge a downturn
trade_ideas.rationale: A weak reading across several cyclical indicators is a stronger signal of an impending downturn than any one alone.
trade_ideas.risk: Each indicator is imperfect on its own.

risk_factors: Cboe notes the corporate KPI market is currently almost entirely retail, so institutional two-way liquidity is not yet established.
Cboe's disclaimers state the products are complex, involve risk of loss and are suitable only for sophisticated market participants.
charts_described: Exhibit 3 ranks the top 10 most traded KPI series on Kalshi, Jan-Aug 2026: Tesla quarterly vehicle deliveries 1.76M contracts, Cava restaurant count 1.56M, Tesla vehicle production 1.25M, Robinhood Gold subscribers 1.18M, Meta headcount 0.90M, Uber trips 0.77M, Philip Morris ZYN pouch shipments 0.64M, Coinbase monthly users 0.57M, Coinbase trading volume 0.52M, Lyft rides 0.51M.
vol_and_positioning: KPI binary options let a holder hedge earnings risk without paying the volatility premium embedded in standard equity options.

Equity vol desks can compare KPI-implied odds with implied volatility and skew on the same name. Cboe's example: KPI options imply a high chance of an EPS shortfall while equity skew stays flat, suggesting downside protection is underpriced.
Retail positioning in KPI contracts skews to longshots, with 37% of contracts at 10 cents or less.

theme_stances.key_argument: A securities options structure puts the product in a regime risk systems, compliance teams and mandates already know how to approve, easing institutional adoption.
theme_stances.evidence: paving the way for easier institutional adoption
